item.title: LOT-088: edit own messages and delete later posts
item.body:
LOT-088
Closes #180
Claim: mac/lot-088

**Problem.** The message menu's "Editer" and "Supprimer" had no handler, so a member could neither correct nor delete an own message.

**Cause.** LOT-087 hides an action without a handler; this lot was deferred until LOT-185 merged.

**Change.** Spec: `docs/lots/LOT-088-edit-delete.md`.
- Edit: the edit form is read (`EditPrefill`), the composer opens on it, title "Edition". A first post also edits its title and, on a public topic, its sub-category. The form is fetched again at send and must be that message's. Draft per message; an untouched edit stores none.
- Delete: legacy alert (Non / Oui), nothing leaves before "Oui". Not offered on the first post, and `PostingFlow.deleteLaterPost` refuses a first-post form with nothing sent (LOT-175 owns that delete).
- Success only on HFR's sentence. `unconfirmed` is never reported as success and never resent; the page reloads so the user can check.
- Why this wide: two engine additions only (`edit(subcategory:)`, `deleteLaterPost`), the rest reuses `PostingFlow` and the composer views. Computed properties of `ReplyComposerModel` moved to `+Posting` to stay under the type length limit.
- **Decision to review:** LOT-048 asks a whole-topic confirmation of every public delete (fail closed). `deleteLaterPost` lifts it for a form with no first-post sign on a message the page does not call the first post: two checks, on captures `R62a` and `R63b`.

**Tests.** `PostingEditDeleteTests` (engine, captures `R62a`, `R63b`, `R43a`, `R43b`, `R44`, answers `W16a`, `W31`, `W32`, `W34`), `EditPrefillTests`, `EditComposerTests`, `MessageWriteModelTests` (app-hosted, real toolbars `R63a`, forms, `R130b`). No HFR write.
Shown to fail without the change (mutations run): engine: no first-post sign check, no message check, `subcat` not sent, whole-topic flag not passed; app: prefill ignored, `differsFromPrefill` always true, subject not sent, no `numreponse` check on the link, delete without asking, unconfirmed delete shown as success, reload through a followed anchor (separator drawn).
Full suite: 1023 passed on the iPhone 18 Pro clone (head, merged with dev-swift); 1012 on the iPad Pro 13-inch clone at 2f5f9523, iOS 27.0. Review round: Send needs a change on an edit (`anUntouchedEditCannotBeSent`, shown to fail without the rule); a kept draft winning over the form is accepted in the spec.

**Pending capture** (spec has the detail; no state hand-built):
1. First-post edit with a changed `sujet` or `subcat`: `W34`, `W35` sent them as served. Whether HFR applies them is not captured.
2. First-post edit form of a topic without sub-category ("Aucune"; HFR-091 is cited by #180 but not found in the legacy tree).
3. Topic page after a delete, and a private thread's page past its end when the deleted message was alone on the last page.
4. Edit form of a message in a locked topic (#131).
5. Edit form as served for a first post of a topic with a poll.

**Mac check needed**
- [ ] Edit a later post, then the first post (title, sub-category, private first post): prefill, send, banner, page reloaded at the message.
- [ ] Delete a later post: alert, banner, scroll position kept; "Supprimer" absent on the first post.
- [ ] Progress overlay on a slow form read, "Edition impossible" with "Réessayer" offline.
- [ ] Light, dark, Dynamic Type XL; iPhone and iPad.
- [ ] Merging with #552 (LOT-186): both touch `TopicReaderView`, `TopicReaderModel`, `CHANGELOG-LEGACY`.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * You can edit your own messages, with existing text and available subject or subcategory filled in.
  * You can delete eligible later messages after confirming the action.
  * Edit drafts are kept separately for each message, and unchanged form content is not saved as a draft.
  * Forum links can open in the reader, profile sheet, or selected browser; supported message videos display as embeds.
* **Bug Fixes**
  * Edit and delete outcomes are reported more accurately, including when the result is uncertain. The topic refreshes after confirmed changes.
  * First-message deletion is refused because it could delete the entire topic.

Walkthrough

This change adds editing for eligible own messages and deletion for eligible later posts. It connects these actions to the topic reader, adds edit-form prefills and per-message drafts, and reloads reader content after applicable write outcomes. It also adds topic-reader link routing and video lookup helpers. **Changes: Own-message editing and deletion** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Edit and delete posting contracts**

Edit submission can include a validated subcategory. Later-post deletion checks the form and refuses first-post or mismatched forms. Tests cover form fields, subcategories, and deletion guards.| |**Edit composer and drafts**
`App/SwiftHFR/Composer/*`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Composer/*`, `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-088-edit-delete.md`|The composer loads edit-form text and applicable subject and subcategory values. Tests cover prefills, sending, uncertain outcomes, and draft behavior.| |**Reader edit and delete actions**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Actions/*`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Actions/*`, `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-088-edit-delete.md`, `docs/migration/GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md`|The reader adds edit and delete menu actions, deletion confirmation, failure handling, and reload behavior. Tests cover action availability, confirmation, and reloads.| **Reader link and video lookup** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Reader link and video lookup**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel+Links.swift`|HTTP(S) links route to a recognized reader target, a profile sheet, or the selected browser. Video lookup returns an embed only when the document token and requested message and embed index match.| **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant TopicReaderView participant MessageWriteModel participant LiveReplyPoster participant PostingFlow participant TopicReaderModel TopicReaderView->>MessageWriteModel: Open edit action MessageWriteModel->>LiveReplyPoster: Load edit prefill LiveReplyPoster->>PostingFlow: Read and validate edit form PostingFlow-->>LiveReplyPoster: Return form data LiveReplyPoster-->>MessageWriteModel: Return edit prefill MessageWriteModel-->>TopicReaderView: Present edit composer MessageWriteModel->>LiveReplyPoster: Submit edit LiveReplyPoster->>PostingFlow: Post edited message PostingFlow-->>MessageWriteModel: Return posting result MessageWriteModel->>TopicReaderModel: Show confirmation and reload post ``` **Possibly related issues** - [ezzz/HFRnow#324](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/324): Tracks LOT-088 and own-message editing, which this change implements. **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#398](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/398): Adds private-message targets and subject drafts extended by edit targets and drafts. - [ezzz/HFRnow#466](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/466): Adds the subject field and subcategory picker used for first-post editing. - [ezzz/HFRnow#294](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/294): Adds the reply composer, draft lifecycle, and posting service extended by the edit flow.
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to 41d82

Edit-form retry errors now use edit-specific wording. No actionable merge-blocking issue is established.
Security architecture risk: Moderate · up to 41d82

Captured cases block first-post deletion, and uncertain writes are not automatically retried. However, the new delete path weakens the fallback safeguard for unrecognized public forms. Misclassification could make an irreversible deletion broader than the user confirmed. **Retained concerns** - **Medium · security · inferred:** The new later-post deletion API treats absence of recognized first-post signs as sufficient to bypass whole-topic confirmation. The reader independently excludes known first posts, but the library receives no independently established later-post status. If both classifications miss a first post, single-message consent can authorize a whole-topic deletion. Captured first-post forms are rejected; the repository does not establish that this failure combination occurs in production.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The inspected operations act through one authenticated account's forum session. Intended effects are editing an owned message, changing first-post topic metadata, or deleting a later message. The conditional deletion-scope concern can extend to the whole topic; the evidence does not establish broader account, service or infrastructure compromise. **Security Findings and Attack Paths** - _inferred_ — The unresolved path requires both a reader first-post misclassification and a form without either recognized first-post sign. The new API would then submit after single-message confirmation. Captured public and private first-post forms fail closed, so this remains a conditional scope-control concern rather than a demonstrated attacker-reachable exploit. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Menu eligibility derives from the server-served edit link, not author text. EditTarget restricts the URL to the forum's HTTPS origin and matching topic/message identifiers; fresh edit forms must match the message. The existing submission layer additionally restricts form destinations, checks session identity and disables POST redirect following. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — Recovery preserves uncertainty rather than claiming success: deletion reloads after an unconfirmed outcome, while the edit composer can retain its draft and close to check the topic. The lot explicitly documents no cross-device conflict detection and incomplete private-thread end-page capture coverage. **Hardening Proposals** - _proposed_ — Preserve whole-topic confirmation whenever deletion scope cannot be positively established, or require independently validated later-post status at the library boundary rather than treating absence of first-post signs as sufficient evidence.

review_comments.body:
** Major** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Quick win** **Fix the SwiftLint `cyclomatic_complexity` failure in `message(for:newMessage:newTopic:edit:)`.** The SwiftLint check reports complexity 11 for this function. The limit is 10. The new `edit` branches pushed it over. Three ternaries on Line 11 build the `what` noun. Move them into a helper. AGENTS.md says SwiftLint must pass and CI is authoritative. This failure blocks merge.
♻️ Proposed fix

```diff - let what = newTopic ? "le sujet" : newMessage ? "le message" : edit ? "la modification" : "la réponse" + let what = writtenThing(newTopic: newTopic, newMessage: newMessage, edit: edit) ``` Add the helper to `ComposerMessages`: ```swift /// What the user wrote, as the sentence names it. private static func writtenThing(newTopic: Bool, newMessage: Bool, edit: Bool) -> String { if newTopic { return "le sujet" } if newMessage { return "le message" } return edit ? "la modification" : "la réponse" } ```
As per coding guidelines: "CI is authoritative: the build, tests, lint, CodeQL, dependency review, and secret scan must be green for completion."

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Use edit wording when the edit form re-read fails.** `retrySubcategories()` re-reads the edit form for an `.edit` target. On failure, it calls `ComposerMessages.subcategoriesUnavailable(error)`. That function writes new-topic text. - `.notLoggedIn` says "pour envoyer ce sujet". - `.formUnavailable`, `.formMismatch`, `.unsupportedForm`, `.invalidFormURL` and `.missingAction` give "Le formulaire de nouveau sujet du forum n'est pas pris en charge".
